notes: Budgetabstimmung covers a shared budget for any group, including a team, club or informal gathering. Bürgerhaushalt and Bürgerbudget imply a municipal context and should not label this general-purpose feature. The product owner explicitly wants the wording to cover small-scale use cases too.
Budgetabstimmung selects projects with costs under a shared budget. Punkteverteilung lets each participant distribute points among options; keep the two question types distinct.
Pairwise margins are differences in vote counts, not percentages or merely which option has a majority. Use Stimmendifferenzen consistently for these numeric margins.
